statements.quote: we have mentioned last time that H2 will be better than H1
statements.target: Overall revenue growth to be stronger in H2 vs H1

statements.quote: we expect growth, and we will not be in a position to put any numbers now, but we expect growth in that quarter
statements.target: Positive top-line growth expected; no quantitative guidance provided

statements.quote: we will see continued growth from trucks and off-highway hopefully for years to come in future... it will be healthier growth
statements.target: Sustained double-digit growth in CV / off-highway segment (analyst noted double-digit CV growth is needed to sustain overall company growth)

statements.quote: 9% is where we say that this solution is based on AI... we expect this to go up significantly
statements.target: AI-based revenue share to increase materially from current 9% level (no specific target given)

statements.quote: by Q4, for sure when we talk about next year, we will give you clearly the parameters which we will track internally
statements.target: Management commits to disclosing internal KPIs and product-revenue breakdown by Q4 at the latest

statements.quote: by the end of first quarter next year, the consolidation process will be meaningfully concluded
statements.target: European OEM vendor-consolidation wave expected to be largely complete by end of Q1 FY28, with some revenue impact during FY28

statements.quote: we will be in a position to more than make up for this, during this time from the broad-based growth strategy we talked about
statements.target: Expect to more than offset revenue impact from European OEM budget cuts via broad-based growth strategy

analyst_pushback: Analyst asked whether H2 margin could return to the 20-21% EBITDA range the company "used to operate at"; management addressed the levers (volume, AI productivity, China learnings) but did not explicitly re-commit to a 20-21% target figure.
